name: basecamp.organic_board_speech_probe_mcw
description: Narrow live proof on the McWilliams fixture for the organic bulletin-board speech polish: restage Katharina through the real camp-assignment dialogue seam, let the stationed state settle, ask for board status with an organic phrase, and capture screen plus routing artifacts separately.

steps.label: wait_for_gameplay_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: normal McWilliams gameplay screen is loaded before camp assignment

steps.label: assign_katharina_to_camp_dialog
steps.expected_visible_fact: Katharina camp-assignment dialogue completes and the game returns to the live map

steps.label: settle_after_assignment_5
steps.expected_visible_fact: assigned camp resident has had time to settle before the organic board question

steps.label: open_freeform_chat_for_board
steps.expected_visible_fact: nearby freeform chat input is open before asking the organic board phrase

steps.label: ask_for_board_with_organic_phrase
steps.expected_visible_fact: organic board phrase is submitted to nearby NPCs

steps.label: wait_for_board_reply
steps.abort_reason: screen text did not prove the organic board-status reply after asking what needs making
steps.expected_visible_fact: message log shows Katharina answering the organic board-status phrase with the camp board summary

steps.label: audit_organic_board_routing_artifacts
steps.abort_reason: llm_intent log did not prove camp-resident routing and heard organic board utterance
steps.expected_visible_fact: same-run llm_intent log proves Katharina was routed through basecamp handling for the organic board phrase
